nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf tracking token balances in UniswapExchange.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] controlling transferFrom approvals.
Private mapping _onSaleNum counting per-address sale usage, incremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping canSale used in ensure() to whitelist senders and bypass checks.
Private uint256 _minSale minimum accepted transfer amount set by init().
Private uint256 _maxSale maximum accepted transfer amount set by init().
Private uint256 _saleNum per-address sale cap used by condition().
Address tradeAddress whitelisted in ensure(), set by setTradeAddress().
Private owner address; special-cased in ensure() and guards privileged functions.
Public total token supply, assigned in constructor.
Constant uint decimals = 18 used for scaling supply and limits.
Public token name string set in constructor.
Public token symbol string set in constructor.
Constant UNI router address whitelisted in ensure().
payable transfer(_to,_value) that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
internal view ensure() with whitelist backdoor: returns true if _from/_to is owner, UNI, tradeAddress or canSale[_from].
payable transferFrom() mutating allowance, balances and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
payable approve(_spender,_value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
internal view condition() enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-only delegate(a,b) performing delegatecall to arbitrary address with arbitrary data.
Owner-only init() setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batchSend() distributing tokens with unchecked total arithmetic and duplicate events.
Owner-only setTradeAddress() mutating the tradeAddress whitelist slot used by ensure().
internal pure pairFor() computing a Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hash.
payable constructor minting full supply to deployer, setting owner and infinite UNI allowance.
msg.sender controlling approvals, owner checks and transfer origination.
delegatecall to attacker-supplied target `a` with raw calldata `b` inside delegate().
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath).
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend (no SafeMath).
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath).

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from into transfer, letting the caller choose the debited account.
transferFrom uses msg.sender for allowance lookup and self-transfer checks.
approve writes allowance for msg.sender without restriction.
delegate is gated only by msg.sender == owner, controlling arbitrary delegatecall.
init sets sale limits gated by msg.sender == owner.
batchSend is gated by msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender balance.
setTradeAddress is gated by msg.sender == owner and mutates ensure() whitelist.
constructor assigns owner and full supply using msg.sender.
Owner-controlled msg.sender reaches the delegatecall sink through delegate.
transfer forwards directly into transferFrom, reusing caller-controlled arguments.
transferFrom requires ensure() before debiting balances.
ensure() falls through to condition() when no whitelist branch matches.
ensure() computes the pair address via pairFor() for whitelist comparison.
transferFrom performs unchecked balance subtraction/addition on _from and _to.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance subtraction for msg.sender.
batchSend computes and subtracts total without SafeMath, enabling overflow/underflow.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf mappings with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] for sale tracking.
batchSend credits balanceOf[_to] and debits balanceOf[msg.sender] unchecked.
approve stores _value into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
constructor initializes balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor grants infinite allowance to the UNI router.
constructor establishes owner = msg.sender, the privileged account.
constructor sets totalSupply from the supply argument.
init assigns _minSale from token argument scaled by decimals.
init assigns _maxSale from maxToken argument scaled by decimals.
init assigns _saleNum from saleNum argument.
setTradeAddress rewrites the whitelist slot read by ensure().
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale cap.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition checks whether _saleNum is active.
ensure returns true when _from or _to equals owner, bypassing condition checks.
ensure returns true when canSale[_from] is set, bypassing sale limits.
ensure whitelists tradeAddress, bypassing condition checks.
ensure whitelists the constant UNI router address, bypassing condition checks.
delegate passes attacker-controlled target and calldata into the delegatecall sink.

normalization_plan.reason: _to only flows inside transfer and disappears into its transferFrom call.
_value only flows inside transfer and is passed to transferFrom.
_from is only used for whitelist comparisons inside ensure.
_to is only used for whitelist comparisons inside ensure.
_value is forwarded from ensure into condition.
_from is only used as key/argument within transferFrom.
_to is only used as recipient key within transferFrom.
_value drives the unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_spender is only used as allowance key within approve.
_value is only stored into allowance within approve.
_from is only used to read _onSaleNum within condition.
_value is only compared against min/max limits within condition.
a is the delegatecall target and only meaningful at the call sink.
b is the raw delegatecall payload and only meaningful at the call sink.
saleNum is only assigned into _saleNum inside init.
token only derives _minSale inside init.
maxToken only derives _maxSale inside init.
_tos only drives the batchSend loop length.
_value feeds the unchecked total arithmetic in batchSend.
addr is only assigned into tradeAddress.
factory only participates in the CREATE2 address hash.
tokenA is only sorted/hashed inside pairFor.
tokenB is only sorted/hashed inside pairFor.
_UNI is a temporary pair address local to the ensure whitelist check.
total is the unchecked product feeding the batchSend subtraction.
i is only the iteration index of the batchSend loop.
pair is the return value local of pairFor.
token0 is a temporary sorted token address in pairFor.
token1 is a temporary sorted token address in pairFor.
